title: Nature's Flower Cutting
description: Fixes, standardizes, and adds missing cutting board recipes for Nature's Spirit flowers
body:
I noticed that [Nature's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-delight) uses the wrong tag for its flower cutting recipes, rendering them unusable. While [Farmer's Cutting: Nature's Spirit](https://modrinth.com/datapack/farmers-cutting-natures-spirit) does have recipes that remedy this, they are inconsistent. Additionally both of these are missing multiple flowers all together. So here is my solution!

### Consistency
All recipe's increase the dye received by 1.
- Small Flowers: 2
- Medium Flowers: 3
- Large Flowers: 5
### Recipes Added
Added all missing flowers
### Bonus Recipes
- Coconut: Follows same logic as flowers, supplying 3 for cutting
- Pizza: Another recipe that was broken due to incorrect knife tag
